entities.summary: Walter S. Judd was an American botanist and taxonomist, and distinguished professor in the Department of Botany, University of Florida beginning in 2009. Judd was born in Fairbanks, Alaska; his family relocated to Shiawassee CO, Michigan. Due to the rural setting, it inspired him to study natural history, botany, plant taxonomy and systematics, and phylogenetics.
